Alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Alex: Done: rolled out prewarm script to ams1, validated spot fallback logic.
Alex: Blocker: AMS spot quota still tight; need quota bump or extra reserved nodes.
Alex: Today: will open support ticket + coordinate with cloud-team, planning to prewarm ams2 later.

Priya: Done: tweaked autoscaler policy (target_util=0.7) and fixed a regression in scale-down.
Priya: Blocker: seeing tail latency spikes ~200-300ms on p4s under certain seq lengths. @Jamal can you check kernel selection logs?
Priya: Cmd I ran: `rbxctl logs --since 1h | grep kernel_select`

Jamal: On it.
Jamal: I found one window with `kernel_select: fallback->int8_path (latency +13ms)` in ams1 around 18:05 UTC.
Jamal: Might be a quant table mismatch, pushing a quick fix to staging.

Mei: FYI I temp-bumped reserve for ams2 +2 nodes for next 6h to buy headroom :eyes:

infra-bot: autoscaler: scale-up triggered for ams1 at 18:12 UTC (added 1 p4) reason=spot-eviction

Priya: Thanks — Alex, do you want me to hold the canary if queue draining isn't clean?

Alex: Not yet, will run drain in ~10m and post status here.

Jamal: Fix merged to staging. I'll watch metrics for 30m and follow up.

Alex: Done drain, canary resumed. Will keep monitoring. Ping me if anything else.
